info.name: MediConnect REST API
info.description: Local NestJS / TypeORM / MySQL API verification. Run npm run dev:offline or npm run api:offline, then use Postman Desktop with the local/desktop agent. No cloud database or internet is required after dependencies are installed. Set private patient, doctor and admin credentials in collection variables and run folders in order. Only synthetic records created by the collection are used for CRUD tests.

body.raw:
{
  "fullName": "Updated Patient",
  "phone": null,
  "dateOfBirth": null,
  "gender": null,
  "address": null,
  "emergencyContact": null,
  "bloodType": null,
  "allergies": null
}

exec: pm.test('Only the synthetic user is deactivated', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.isActive).to.equal(false));
